complete_examples.text: It is a difficult problem to estimate the tail behaviors of nonzero mean PDF solutions accurately, especially at the non-stationary state.

The numerical analysis illustrates that the extended EPC method is valid and efficient for achieving the non-stationary nonzero mean PDFs of the responses for the system with strong nonlinearity by comparing the results obtained by extended EPC method, equivalent linearization method and Monte Carlo simulation method.
